title: Step preserves the first branch
statement: Let $N_0,N_1$ be finite nondeterministic Turing machines with Boolean symbols, let $x$ be a Boolean input, let $b\in\{0,1\}$, and let $c$ be a configuration of $N_0$ on $x$. Taking one step of the combined machine under choice $b$ from the configuration embedded in its first branch gives the embedded configuration obtained by taking that step of $N_0$ from $c$.
hypotheses_covered: $N_0,N_1$ are finite nondeterministic Turing machines with Boolean symbols
